messages:
maria: Heads-up — during last night's KMS alias rotation we started seeing SCIM incremental syncs create orphaned roles for a handful of service-accounts. Noticed TTLs dropping to 0 and role entries with `null` externalId.
sachin: ugh. any recent RBAC schema changes? can you paste the scim delta and a sample api payload?
maria: no RBAC schema changes. SCIM agent version stayed the same. paste from logs:
```
2026-03-19T02:18:02Z scim-worker[pid=2245] INFO delta: [{"op":"update","id":"usr_7f2","roles":[{"id":null,"name":"svc-read"}]}]
2026-03-19T02:18:03Z kms-client WARN decrypt failed keyAlias=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rw/cryptoKeys/rotated-key-v2: DecryptError: context mismatch
2026-03-19T02:18:05Z scim-worker ERROR apply-delta failed for id=usr_7f2: role externalId missing, aborting
```
jen: ops-bot pushed the KMS alias swap at 02:15; there were transient decrypt warnings for ~90s. ops-bot, can you confirm if any replay/backfill ran afterwards?
ops-bot: @jen confirmed KMS alias swap executed. No automated backfill invoked. Alert ID `ALERT-8891`: 02:15–02:16 transient decrypt warnings, auto-resolve 02:17. No further action scheduled.
sachin: hypothesis: scim-worker reads encrypted role metadata (externalId) and on decrypt failure treats it as missing then writes role with null id. That would create orphaned role objects when subsequent reconciler expects externalId present.
maria: i can repro locally by forcing decrypt to throw and running `scim-sync --apply --delta-only` against staging dataset. sample repro command:
```
SCIM_AGENT_MODE=delta SCIM_SIMULATE_KMS_ERR=1 ./bin/scim-sync --target=staging --delta-only
```
sam: how many users impacted in prod? we should block any rollout and put a short freeze on scim deltas until we have a fix.
maria: ~12 service accounts across two orgs flagged so far. no human-facing accounts. impact: missing role mapping causing some CI jobs to lack token-scoped perms.
jen: mitigation steps:
- pause SCIM delta workers (set `scim.delta.enabled=false` in the console)
- add defensive guard: if decrypt fails, retry x3 with exponential backoff and do not write partial role objects
- schedule a backfill job to reconcile `externalId==null` entries using last-known mapping from audit log
sachin: agree. also add a short-term fallback: if externalId missing but name matches known service role pattern `svc-*`, don't persist id=null — log and skip.
maria: i've opened GH issue rw/scim#542 and a runbook stub. adding logs and short repro steps. will implement retry + skip-when-name-match. target hotfix in the next deploy window (in 2 hours).
sam: i'll notify affected customers in case CI runs fail. +1 on freeze until hotfix.
jen: one more ask — after hotfix, run backfill with `--dry-run` then `--apply`, and include a signed audit entry per changed role (we need proof for compliance). Also record KMS rotation timeline in the incident note.
maria: noted. plan: freeze -> hotfix -> dry-run backfill -> apply -> compliance audit notes. I'll update the incident doc and ping infra for postmortem.
sachin: thanks. @ops-bot mark ALERT-8891 as linked to this thread and add postmortem tag.
ops-bot: ACK: linked alerts (ALERT-8891). Created incident `INC-2026-0319-12` with severity P2 and assigned to eng-security.
maria: thanks all. I'll post the patch link here once ready. :+1:
